content.text:
The feature `rollback-mechanism-10` has been implemented successfully. Here's a summary of the changes:

1. **`src/agents/types.ts`**: Added `featureCommitShas?: Record<string, string>` to `ProgressState` interface — allows tracking which commit SHA implemented each passing feature.

2. **`src/orchestrator.ts`**: 
   - Imported `writeFeaturesFile` 
   - In `implementFeature()`: after a feature passes, records the commit SHA into `featureCommitShas` in progress
   - Added `rollbackFeature(featureId, regressorFeatureId?)` method that: reads the stored SHA, runs `git revert <sha> --no-commit`, creates a commit with message `"revert: rollback <name> due to regression"`, marks feature(s) as `passes:false`, removes SHA from progress, and updates `passedFeatures` count

3. **`src/cli.ts`**: Added `quest rollback <feature-id>` command with optional regressor argument

All 393 tests pass (up from 378 passing — the 15 rollback tests now pass).
